name: DolphinBench routed-v4 FULL 600 (verified standing facts)
objective: Run all 600 DolphinBench tasks once under the validated dolphin-routed-v4 condition (verified standing facts, routing guard, commit checkpoint), grade with the original checks, and deliver an independently validated full result and human-readable report. Self-tested; never replay; never patch fixtures.
plan: Owner authorization 2026-10-31 (Javad): run the full 600 under the validated dolphin-routed-v4 condition after the fixed20 pilot passed independent validation at 17/20 with 0 regressions. Exact-command worker; one durable launch intent; the launcher path --stage full --confirm-full-run with the frozen condition, receipts (re-admitted at every task boundary, 24h window) and $20 cap. Reader Luna/high via subscription, judge Sol/medium OpenRouter Azure-only, local memory/Ollama, state assessors disabled, all unchanged. Recovery is inspect-only (resumeArgv --reconcile-only); never relaunch scored work, reset app state, delete evidence or invent charges. A $0 subscription transport failure may be reconciled only with the owner-authorized scripts/reconcile_subscription_failures.py, preserving the original accounting. The result is self-tested and not an official submission; the published 390/600 is unchanged until reviewed. The independent validator decides acceptance.

Independent validation matches handoff and reports recoveries and any control regressions.

Workspace routed-fixed20 handoff, progress, outcome and Markdown report

dolphin-routed-v1 ordinary inventory with staged guard checkpoint=false; retain sandbox and real-account isolation.

stages: Independently validate evidence and publish terminal report
